# chameleon_storage_bucket (Resource)

Manages an S3 storage bucket in the Chameleon platform. Note: bucket deletion is not supported by the BFF API — destroying this resource logs a warning and removes it from state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chameleon_storage_bucket" "lake" {
  name = "data-lake-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) S3 bucket name. Must be globally unique within the Chameleon platform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Bucket name (used as the Terraform resource ID).
